therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NK1 receptor antagonism and 5-HT3 receptor antagonism
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with cancer experiencing chronic nausea and vomiting
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in Nausea Numerical Rating Scale (NRS) Between Day 5 and Day 15
